subject: uk-aisi-inspect-evals-register

metrics.model_change: May 8, 2026: Inspect Evals moved from central submissions to DISTRIBUTED REGISTER model
metrics.new_path: Host eval in external repo → register via YAML in inspect_evals/register/<eval_name>/eval.yaml
submission_process: 3. Host on GitHub, commit, pin SHA
4. Open 'Register Eval Submission' issue on UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals
5. Bot validates, opens PR, derive metadata from arXiv paper
6. Upload log files of two model eval runs
metrics.contribution_policy: Issue-first: need accepted issue before PR. Qualified contributors can PR directly.
metrics.extension_alternative: Standalone package + one-line PR to extensions listing at inspect.aisi.org.uk/extensions.html
metrics.csoai_implementation: Create gspc-inspect-evals package with @task wrappers for all 22 GSPC axes. Publish on GitHub. Register in inspect_evals.

honest_sentence: CORRECTED PATH: Since May 2026, AISI Inspect uses a DISTRIBUTED REGISTER model. Build gspc-inspect-evals package with @task functions, register via YAML in UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals. Need arXiv paper + 2 model run logs.
